title: First messages that start real conversations

paragraphs: You've chosen each other, so you already know there's interest. A good first message shows you read their profile and gives them something easy to reply to.

sections.heading: Try this
items: Ask about something specific they wrote: “You mentioned Sunday dinners. What's always on the table?”
Share a small connection: “I've hiked that trail too. Did you make it to the waterfall?”
Ask an open question that takes more than one word to answer.

paragraphs: Keep it warm and short, and take your time. Thoughtful replies matter more than fast ones.
